column1: # The EXPECTED DECODE of every pinned golden segment — round-2 finding 3.
# GOLDEN.tsv pins WHICH BYTES were read; this pins WHAT THEY MEAN. A C3 reader
# that frames sections wrongly still matches every sha256 in GOLDEN.tsv, because
# a raw hash attests the input and says nothing about the parse. Each C3 reader
# compares its own decode against this file.
# SCOPE, stated so no one mistakes its absence for an oversight: this pins
# FRAMING — header fields and the (offset, tag, lsn, bodyLen) of every section.
# It deliberately does NOT pin decoded 'S'/'C'/'K' BODY semantics. walfmt is a
# structural codec; reimplementing store record semantics in python would be a
# fifth implementation that no one reviews, and the frozen Java reader is the
# authority for what a body MEANS. Body-level agreement is a C3 obligation
# (contract §11.2), checked engine-against-engine, not against this file.
# Regenerate together with GOLDEN.tsv; the self-test fails if the two disagree.
